aur:adsb-monitor.name: ADS-B Feeder Monitor

aur:android-tv-remote.description: Control an Android TV over the network via ADB

aur:ascii-draw.description: Draw diagrams and more using ASCII

aur:azbuka-git.name: Azbuka

aur:billtracker.name: Bill & Savings Tracker

aur:bobby.name: Bobby

aur:cairn.name: Cairn

aur:cassette.description: Unofficial Yandex Music client for GNOME

aur:cobang.description: Scan and decode QR from camera or static image

aur:codimux.name: CoDiMux
notes: Some of it runs off the edge

aur:concessio.name: Concessio
notes: Some of it runs off the edge

aur:confy.name: Confy

aur:conjure.name: Conjure

aur:coulr.description: Color box to help developers and designers

aur:dissent.description: A Discord client in Go and GTK4

aur:dosage-tracker.name: Dosage
aur:dosage-tracker.summary: Dosage is built for a narrow screen: the Today and Treatments lists, the full-width New Treatment form and the bottom tab bar all fit at 360px, with large touch targets and nothing cut off.

aur:drew.description: Image annotation for Wayland. Bells and whistles included

aur:emendo.name: Emendo

aur:flare.description: Chat with your friends on Signal
aur:flare.name: Flare

aur:flowtime.description: Get what motivates you done, without losing concentration

aur:formiko.description: reStructuredText and MarkDown editor and live html previewer

aur:gelly.name: Gelly

aur:tomatillo.summary: Does not start on the phone: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'gi.repository'
